notes.title: Just a Village Clicker Update!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Villagers![/h3]

First of all, I would like to thank everyone who bought the game!
Thank you very much, I’m really happy with the results and the feedback!

We are starting the year with a small update to improve the user experience.
Check out the changes!

[b]Fix:[/b]
Reducing the enemy's armor to below 0 now correctly amplifies the damage instead of healing.

[b]Update:[/b]
Battles don't last long, so we’re reducing the cooldown time so they can be used more than once in battle:
Cooldown time for spells reduced to 12s.

All the best!
Ankouz

notes.title: Release date of Just a Village Clicker scheduled for 12/24/24
notes.notes:
Hello villagers!

After a few months of development, we have a release date for Just a Village Clicker!

The game will be released on [b]December 24, 2024[/b], one day before Christmas, so... How about gifting this relaxing little game to someone important to you? Hehe.

This is my first time publishing a game on a major platform, so I'm definitely very anxious about all of this, but I'm doing my best to deliver a quality and fun project for the player.

I know there might still be some errors and bugs, but it seems that everything is going according to plan. A big thank you to the testers for helping me polish this final stage!

Soon, I want to talk more about the game's narrative and some mechanics, so stay tuned!

Wishing you a great end of the year <3

- Ankouz
